rv.q: For audiences who love heavy metal rock music, this is the play to see.
Airness, now playing at the Citadel Theatre, delivers a rocking good time, laughs, and a rock classic earworm to follow you home.
The bar décor (complete with working mini-fridge) is the perfect setting for the play.
Airness is not the greatest script ever, but it definitely has its moments.

cn.t: Critics find this quirky comedy about competitive air guitar delivers laughs and heart, as newcomer Nina discovers the joy and transcendence in the subculture while confronting her own insecurities.
